Your layout, literally.
Player 25% / lyrics 50% / search 25%.

Tradeoff: the results list is capped at ~3 songs, and the mixer has to collapse to fit the player into 25%.

Search opens a sheet over the lyrics.

Lyrics keep the full 50% while you are singing; searching gets the whole list plus the Request button. Costs one tap to dismiss.

Lyrics take everything; player is a slim bar, search is a floating button.

Most lyric space, closest to a TV view. Shows the romanised line under the active one.
